name: Tkinter Live Inspector
description: A browser-devtools-style inspector for Tkinter apps: hover any widget to outline it and see its class, path, size and styling, with colours and fonts mapped back to the app's design tokens.
highlights: Finds the deepest widget under the cursor by recursing into the smallest containing child
Click-through highlight overlay using a transparent-colour Toplevel, plus a floating HUD that stays on screen
Resolves ttk style lookups and maps raw hex colours and font tuples back to the app's named design tokens

media.caption: The inspector attached to a small Tk/ttk window with its own design tokens: hovering outlines each widget, and the HUD maps its colours and fonts back to the token names (pointer path scripted)
